name: mcp-creative
description: Open-source design and media: Penpot (Figma alternative), ComfyUI (local image/video/audio generation), Blender (3D), plus Figma context and fal (paid cloud video models).

figma_api_key.title: Figma personal access token
figma_api_key.description: Figma > Settings > Security > Personal access tokens. Leave empty if you use Penpot only.

fal_key.title: fal API key
fal_key.description: fal.ai > Dashboard > Keys. Paid per generation. Leave empty to stay fully local with ComfyUI.
